t: The LAP Fulgora fixed downlight is a round, white bezel fitting designed for indoor lighting installations. This downlight is suitable for domestic use, ideal for illuminating living rooms, hallways, or bedrooms. It requires 1 x GU10 light bulb (sold separately) and features a robust metal body construction. The IP20 rating confirms its suitability for dry indoor environments. Installation is straightforward with a 65-72mm cut-out diameter and screwless connections for wiring, ensuring a secure and efficient setup. The slim 32mm depth allows for versatile placement.
b: Loop In & Loop Out Terminals Simplify Wiring
Round Shape & Sleek Design Enhances Interiors
